backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor placeholder with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented slideshow features and associated source files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing purposes of various frontend components involved in the Valentine slideshow.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining color variables, dark mode theming, and base styling for the app.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component managing pre-intro animation, ambient effects, music playback, and slideshow rendering.
frontend/src/components/ambient/AmbientO: Generates floating heart and sparkle particles unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/ambient/HeartPar: Renders a subtle heart particle background field with randomized positions and animation timing.
frontend/src/components/ambient/usePrefe: Hook detecting the user's prefers-reduced-motion system setting.
frontend/src/components/audio/MusicContr: Handles autoplaying looping background music after user interaction and exposes a mute toggle.
frontend/src/components/audio/MusicToggl: Button UI for toggling music mute/unmute state with icon feedback.
frontend/src/components/effects/HeartCon: Creates falling heart confetti for celebratory effects unless reduced-motion is enabled.
frontend/src/components/effects/Valentin: Generates falling heart, star, and moon confetti for enhanced transition celebrations.
frontend/src/components/intro/PreIntroAn: Displays a staged fade-in/hold/fade-out Valentine intro animation with hearts, respecting reduced-motion preference and calling onComplete when finished.
frontend/src/components/loveletters/Love: Renders a love letter card that can open to show an editable photo area and notes, supporting pasted images and animated entry delays.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenCl: Shows a closing Valentine screen with animated hearts and a large textarea for a final note plus a footer credit link.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenFi: Displays an image and a textarea for a final message, ending with a 'Continue' button to advance.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenHa: Shows a happy dancing character with celebratory text and a button to continue.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenIn: Simple intro screen with a large greeting and a continue button.
Reveals an introductory message with fade-in timing before offering a continue button.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenKi: Displays a kissing animation with heart particles and delayed text, ending with a continue button.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenLo: Renders a grid of interactive love letter cards with editable photos and notes, and provides a continue button.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenMo: Runs a moonrise, envelope-opening, and letter-emerging animation, then provides a textarea for writing a message and a continue button.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenPr: Displays a proposal screen with celebratory animation and advances after the user clicks either button.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenSt: Shows a love story animation sequence and a continue button to proceed.
frontend/src/components/screens/ScreenVa: Presents a Valentine question with animations, NO-handling logic, and confetti on YES before continuing.
frontend/src/components/story/LoveStoryA: Cycles through story frames with optional reduced-motion behavior and clickable thumbnails to select frames.
frontend/src/components/transitions/Scre: Wraps children with fade/scale transition logic respecting reduced-motion preferences.
frontend/src/components/ValentineSlidesh: Controller that cycles through 11 screens with transition animations and next-step navigation.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login, stored identity, and status states.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Empty file indicating no backend queries are used.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind base styles and custom romantic-themed colors, utilities, buttons, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom romantic color palette, typography, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores project version, high-level design summary, architectural notes, required images, and existing feature definitions for an 11‑page animated Valentine slideshow site.
